page.layout: One page of text, single column, no margin notes. Top to bottom: dedication lines in large capitals with names, then the closing signature line.

main_text.p: Dn. ADRIANO GOTTIER, Præfecto in Fraubrunnen cum applausu nuper electo.
Dn. EMANUELI BONDELINO, Ducentum - Viro spectatissimo, Physices & Eloquentiæ Professori solertissimo.
Dn. Mecœnatibus ac Promotoribus Munificentissimis, Fautoribus ac benefactoribus omni obsequio colendis,

Illustrissimis, Pietate ac Virtute Clarissimis viris Dn. Scholarchis, Augusti Senatûs Accademicî Assessoribus, Athænei hujus Curatoribus: item totius Cœtus Ecclesiastici Membris, Dominis suis Mecœnatibus studiorum suorum Promotoribus ac Præceptoribus omni reventia, dum Spiritus hos regit artus, colendis.
Dn. SAMUELI BACHMANNO, Ecclesiæ Patriæ Pastori primario classisq; Decano spectatissimo.
Dn. ELISÆO MALACRIDA, Ling. Græc. & Phil. Moral. Professori solidissimo, p t. Rectori Magnifico.
Dn. BEATO JACOBO GANTING, Præconi verbi Divini in Sanen ferventissimo.
Dn. SAMUELI GRUNER, Ecclesiæ in Biglen Pastori fidelissimo.

p.i: Hasce studiorum suorum Primitias grată ac devotâ mente D.D.C.

page.notes: Some letters are blurred at the top and right edges; the page is slightly skewed. Spellings and punctuation follow the print.
